scores.notes: Viewed full size: both are round stone pits with lions on a sandy floor in daylight, palms at the rim and Darius above. The blocks look larger from inside the pit; no entrance is visible on the left to conflict with the right's hatch.

Viewed full size: the Daniel watching the vision has dark hair greying at the temples, a salt-and-pepper short beard, olive skin and a lean face; the banquet Daniel is the same man with his hair cropped a little closer. No clear identity cue conflicts.
Viewed full size: both images show the den's entrance and they conflict, an iron grille at stone steps on the left and a large round wooden door in an arched wall on the right.

Viewed full size: the Daniel watching the vision (dark hair greying at the temples, salt-and-pepper beard, olive skin) matches the smaller Daniel climbing out of the pit (greying hair, grey beard, lean olive face).
